title: SSC Selection Post 14th Recruitment 2026 Admit Card for 3003 Post
postName: SSC Various Selection Post XIV Recruitment 2026 - SSC Phase-XIV/2026/Selection Posts
vacancyDetails: SSC Selection Post Phase XIV: 3,003 vacancies across Matriculation, Higher Secondary and Graduation level posts
qualification: Matriculation, 10+2 Intermediate or Bachelor Degree depending on the notified post
ageLimit: 18 to 25-30 years, post-wise; age relaxation as per SSC Selection Post rules
applicationFee: General / EWS / OBC: Rs. 100; SC / ST / PH and all category female candidates: No fee
selectionProcess: Computer Based Examination -> Document Verification / Skill Test as applicable for the post

howToApply:
1. Visit https://ssc.gov.in/login

3. Open Selection Post Phase XIV exam city or admit card link

shortDescription: Staff Selection Commission SSC has released the notification for Selection Post 14th Matric, Inter and Graduate Level Various Post Examination 2026. Enrolled candidates can download the admit card for 3,003 posts.
content:
Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the notification for Selection Post 14th Matric, Inter and Graduate Level Various Post Examination, 2026. Candidates enrolled in the SSC 14th Selection Post vacancy can download the admit card. Before applying, candidates should read the complete advertisement for the selection procedure, exam syllabus, pattern, exam date and other details.

Staff Selection Commission (SSC)

SSC Various Selection Post XIV Recruitment 2026

SSC Phase-XIV/2026/Selection Posts | Short Details of Notification

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 13/04/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 04/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Exam Fee: 05/05/2026
  • Correction Date: 11-13 May 2026
  • SSC Selection Post 14th Exam Date: 16-26 September 2026
  • Admit Card Available: Before Exam

Application Fee

  • Gen / EWS / OBC: 100/-
  • SC / ST / PH: 0/-
  • All Category Female: 0/-
  • Correction Edit Fee - First Time: 200/-
  • Correction Edit Fee - Second Time: 500/-

Pay the examination fee through online Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking or SBI E Challan offline mode only.

SSC Selection Post XIV Notification 2026: Age Limit as on 01/01/2026

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age: 25-30 Years (Post Wise)

For post-wise age limit details, read the full SSC Selection Post 14th Exam Notification.

SSC Selection Post 14th Recruitment 2026: Vacancy Details

UR: 1534 | EWS: 271 | OBC: 667 | SC: 346 | ST: 185 | Total Post: 3003

SSC Selection Post Eligibility 2026

Matric

Class 10 High School Exam in any recognized board in India.

Intermediate

10+2 Intermediate Exam in any recognized board in India.

Graduation

Bachelor Degree in any stream from any recognized university in India.

SSC Region Name Who Conducted the Selection Post XIV Exam 2026

  • SSC Central Region CR (UP / Bihar)
  • SSC Madhya Pradesh MPR (MP / Chhattisgarh)
  • SSC Northern Region NR Delhi
  • SSC Eastern Region ER
  • SSC Karnataka Kerala KKR
  • SSC North East Region NER
  • SSC North Western Region NWR
  • SSC South Region SR
  • SSC Western Region WR

How to Fill SSC Selection Post XIV Online Form 2026

  • SSC Photo Instruction: The candidate must take a live photo using a webcam. The background should be light, both eyes should be open and the photo should be straight.
  • Read the notification before applying for the SSC Selection Post 14th Recruitment Online Form 2026.
  • Collect eligibility, ID proof, address and basic details before applying.
  • Keep scanned documents ready, including signature and ID proof.
  • Check the preview and every column carefully before submitting the application.
  • If an application fee is required, submit it to complete the form.
  • Take a printout of the final submitted form.
